ValidationRule.description: Prevents candidate-related AI interactions without candidate consent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Candidate__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Candidate__c)), NOT(Candidate__r.Is_Consent_Available__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Candidate consent is required before candidate-related AI processing.
